title: 第一卷 第9章 始帝剑碎片
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

也由此证明，自己的天赋铭刻之主，还算是很不错的。

不然也不可能排名到全球第二。

至于这个叫叶凡的，不出意外，肯定也是个S级的天赋，还是比较倾向于发展的。

圣体碎片，不知道是什么玩意，但肯定不是什么垃圾货色。

自己得到了八百的随机资源，

始帝剑碎片：万古一帝曾经的佩剑，在面对清魔一战之中，佩剑崩碎，集齐十块碎片，始帝剑可重现人间！

始帝剑！

万古一帝的佩剑碎片，集齐十块就有一把完整的始帝剑。

虽然不知道这始帝剑的威力如何，但应该是差不了多少的。

不然不会放在全球排名的奖励之中。

心中倒是很期待集齐一把完整的始帝剑！

每天都会结算排名，也就是说，只要自己保持十天一直都是全球排名前三，就有很大的希望。

虽然有点难度，但秦龙想要拼一把！

就是不知道后面的排名奖励，是不是固定的。

要是固定的，自己还只能排名第二，否则就有可能得不到始帝剑碎片。

不管了，只要在前三，不管谁得到了始帝剑，用相应的东西来换，应该能够得到。

接下来，是区域排行榜。

毫无疑问，秦龙排名在第一！

第一名：秦龙，奖励一百随机资源，大威力左轮手枪一把，手枪通用子弹三十发。

第二名：冷锋，奖励一百随机资源，蜂鸟手枪一把，手枪通用子弹十发。

第三名：霍东风，奖励一百随机资源，梅菜扣肉一盒。

第四名：梅陇，奖励五十随机资源，泡面一桶。

......

总体来说还不错，第一天的排名，前三都是一百随机资源，后面的都是五十随机资源。

剩下的奖励，当真是五花八门有用没用的。

自己作为第一名，得到的奖励当真不错。

大威力的左轮手枪，还有通用子弹三十发。

秦龙大概看了一下，这种左轮，威力十足，精准度更不用说了。

可惜子弹少了一点，只有三十发。

这一下子，自己的木弓可以收起来了，只作为一个备用的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This also proves that his talent as the Master of Inscription is quite good.

Otherwise, it would be impossible to rank second in the world.

As for the man named Ye Fan, no surprise, he must be an S-level talent, and he is more inclined to develop.

I don’t know what the Holy Body fragment is, but it’s definitely not junk.

I got 800 random resources,

Fragments of the First Emperor's Sword: The sword of the Eternal Emperor was shattered into pieces in the battle against the Qing Demon. With ten pieces collected, the First Emperor's Sword can reappear in the world!

The First Emperor's Sword!

The fragments of the sword of the Eternal Emperor, if collected ten pieces, there will be a complete Sword of the First Emperor.

Although I don't know how powerful this Emperor's Sword is, it should be about the same.

Otherwise, it will not be included in the global ranking rewards.

I am really looking forward to collecting a complete First Emperor Sword!

The rankings will be calculated every day, which means that as long as you remain in the top three in the world for ten days, you have great hope.

Although it is a bit difficult, Qin Long wants to give it a try!

I just don’t know if the subsequent ranking rewards are fixed.

If it were fixed, he would have to rank second, otherwise he might not get the fragments of the First Emperor Sword.

No matter, as long as they are in the top three, no matter who gets the First Emperor Sword, they should be able to get it if they exchange it for the corresponding items.

Next, is the regional rankings.

There is no doubt that Qin Long ranks first!

First place: Qin Long, rewarded with 100 random resources, a powerful revolver, and 30 rounds of general-purpose bullets for the pistol.

Second place: Leng Feng, rewarded with 100 random resources, a Hummingbird pistol, and ten general-purpose bullets for the pistol.

Third place: Huo Dongfeng, rewarded with 100 random resources and a box of pickled vegetables and meat.

Fourth place: Mei Long, rewarded with fifty random resources and a bucket of instant noodles.

...

Overall, it's not bad. In the rankings on the first day, the top three are all with 100 random resources, and the ones behind are all with 50 random resources.

The remaining rewards are really all kinds of useful and useless.

As the first place, the reward I got was really good.

A powerful revolver with thirty rounds of general-purpose ammunition.

Qin Long took a quick look and found that this kind of revolver was very powerful, not to mention accurate.

It's a pity that the bullets are a little short, only thirty rounds.

At this moment, his wooden bow can be put away and only used as a spare.
